note: Matching-focused evals. Each run does PARSE + PRICEBOOK MATCH only and stops at the mapping table. Runs must NOT push to Fergus (no create-on-hand) and do NOT need a real job.

evals.name: clean-single-cable
evals.prompt: You're helping enter gear onto a Fergus job for Linc Electrical. Match this dictated gear to real Fergus pricebook items and produce the mapping table only — do NOT push anything to Fergus, and you don't need a job number. Gear: "20 metres of 2.5 TPS".
evals.expected_output: Matches AFLMC0325 'Cable 2.5mm 2c + Earth Circular TPS' (Ideal), treats it as per-metre with quantity 20 (not 1), high confidence, ready to push. No spurious ambiguity.

evals.name: ambiguous-weatherproof-amp
evals.prompt: You're helping enter gear onto a Fergus job for Linc Electrical. Match this dictated gear to real Fergus pricebook items and produce the mapping table only — do NOT push anything to Fergus, and you don't need a job number. Gear: "a weatherproof powerpoint".
evals.expected_output: Recognises multiple real candidates that differ in a way that matters (10A vs 15A, IP53/IP54, white vs matte black) and ASKS for a pick rather than silently choosing one.

evals.name: trap-double-gpo
evals.prompt: You're helping enter gear onto a Fergus job for Linc Electrical. Match this dictated gear to real Fergus pricebook items and produce the mapping table only — do NOT push anything to Fergus, and you don't need a job number. Gear: "three double power points".
evals.expected_output: Does NOT confidently select the oddly-named recessed AV wall outlet (CDYAVRPS03) that a naive 'double power point' search surfaces. Either searches better terms (double socket / double powerpoint) to find a real standard double GPO, or flags it as ambiguous and asks. Quantity 3.

evals.name: downlight-model-pick
evals.prompt: You're helping enter gear onto a Fergus job for Linc Electrical. Match this dictated gear to real Fergus pricebook items and produce the mapping table only — do NOT push anything to Fergus, and you don't need a job number. Gear: "two LED downlights".
evals.expected_output: Surfaces several real downlight models (e.g. Nova, Slick, Lumascan) at their real prices and asks which model rather than silently committing to one. Quantity 2.

evals.name: multi-item-slang
evals.prompt: You're helping enter gear onto a Fergus job for Linc Electrical. Match this dictated gear to real Fergus pricebook items and produce the mapping table only — do NOT push anything to Fergus, and you don't need a job number. Gear: "chuck 15 metres of 1.5 tps, a couple of batten holders, an RCBO, and mileage on it".
evals.expected_output: 1.5 TPS as per-metre qty 15; 2x batten holders; RCBO flagged for rating (amp/pole) since it's ambiguous; mileage recognised as a flat charge ($30 ex GST from the brain) NOT a pricebook search. Nothing invented.
